name: Suou Keito
source:
Born into a warm family consisting of a gentle mother and a police officer father. He's popular in school because of his youthful facial features and bright, refreshing personality.

He's polite and is always kind to the weak. Although his attitude is typically humble, he sometimes says some selfish things unconsciously.

He spends his days longing to live an extraordinary life. He's a member of the lacrosse club and has a dream diary.

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
